summary: The new eviction path in `cache_dict.py` drops the wrong end of the cache.

findings.title: eviction removes the newest entry instead of the oldest
findings.body: `popitem(last=True)` pops the most-recently-used end of the OrderedDict, so the cache evicts the entry it just kept warm. The original code deleted `next(iter(self))`, the LRU end. Fix: `self.popitem(last=False)`.
